{{Quote|I remember the day we were forced to give you up in order to protect the clan.|[[Talzin/Legends|Mother Talzin]]|<ref name="Nightsisters Ep" />}}
This [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] was the '''mother''' of [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. When her daughter was still an infant, she was forced to give her up to [[Hal'Sted/Legends|Hal'Sted]], a [[Siniteen/Legends|Siniteen]] criminal, in order to protect her [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] clan, a decision which caused both her and Mother Talzin great pain. Her daughter would eventually return to her home and become a Nightsister herself.
